capabilities: Validates YAML syntax and Kubernetes manifests against bundled API schemas
Underlines errors in place with hover messages and block summaries
Applies one-click fixes for common mistakes
Checks links between objects in the same note
Scans the whole vault from a side panel
disambiguation: Not a cluster or deployment tool; it only validates YAML and Kubernetes manifests written in notes.
extras: Manual install from release files (main.js, manifest.json, styles.css); everything runs locally with the schema bundled; Helm/Jinja template blocks are skipped and placeholders left alone; UI in English and Turkish.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in validation for YAML or Kubernetes manifests written in notes, so mistakes only surface at deploy time.
summary: Linter that checks YAML and Kubernetes manifests in notes as you write, underlining errors and offering one-click fixes.
